tokens.name: --ftk-spacing-scale
tokens.label: Field spacing
tokens.description: Scales only the vertical gaps between field rows.
tokens.guidance: 100% keeps the original gaps; 200% doubles them. Input padding follows Input size. Section padding has a separate control under Form layout.

tokens.name: --ftk-control-scale
tokens.label: Input size
tokens.description: Scales inputs, their text, inner padding and icons, choice controls, and buttons together.
tokens.guidance: 100% keeps original sizes. 150% makes controls and their text 50% larger. Individual Advanced overrides take priority.

tokens.name: --ftk-radius-scale
tokens.label: Corner scale
tokens.description: Scales the rounding of input, button, choice, and card corners.
tokens.guidance: Use 0 for square corners, 1 for original corners, or 1.25 for slightly softer corners. Circular controls stay circular. Advanced includes separate input, button, and card corners.

tokens.name: --ftk-font-scale
tokens.label: Text size
tokens.description: Scales field labels, help text, headings, stage text, and unformatted rich text. Input text follows Input size.
tokens.guidance: 100% keeps original sizes. Explicit rich-text formatting and component sizes take priority.

tokens.name: --ftk-font-weight-label
tokens.label: Label weight
tokens.description: Controls how light or bold field labels appear.
tokens.guidance: 400 is regular and 700 is bold. Available weights depend on the form font. Clear to inherit the default.

tokens.name: --ftk-border-scale
tokens.label: Border thickness
tokens.description: Scales input, textarea, choice, button, and section border thickness.
tokens.guidance: Try 2 for a clearer outline. Fractional pixels may round to the same displayed width. Individual border overrides take priority.

tokens.name: --ftk-section-padding-inline
tokens.label: Horizontal padding
tokens.description: Sets left and right padding inside form sections.
tokens.guidance: Set 0–128 pixels. Clear to restore existing section padding. Individual edge overrides take priority.

tokens.name: --ftk-section-padding-block
tokens.label: Vertical padding
tokens.description: Sets top and bottom padding inside form sections.
tokens.guidance: Set 0–128 pixels. Clear to restore existing section padding. Individual edge overrides take priority.

tokens.name: --ftk-layout-spacing-scale
tokens.label: Section padding
tokens.description: Scales padding around form sections without changing field gaps or input padding.
tokens.guidance: 100% keeps original section padding. Explicit section padding overrides take priority. Header styling stays unchanged.
